blends.name: 🏁 PIXEL kARTs SPECIAL BLEND EVENT! 🏁
blends.desc:
🏁🏎️ PIXEL kARTs SPECIAL BLEND EVENT! 🏎️🏁

Hey racers and collectors! We’re thrilled to roll out an all-new blend mechanic that lets you turn your sticker NFTs into powerful core collectibles—ready for action in our WAXDAO staking pool. Here’s everything you need to know:

🔍 HOW IT WORKS:

1. Select three sticker NFTs from your wallet.
2. Pay 50 WAX to cover the blend process.
3. Receive a brand-new core collectible of random rarity!
4. Stake it immediately in the WAXDAO pool to start earning rewards.

❗ WHY BLEND?
• Unlock exclusivity: These core NFTs can’t be minted or dropped anywhere else—only through blending!
• Boost your portfolio: Add rare and high-value collectibles to your collection.
• Start earning NOW: Instant staking means no downtime—your NFT starts working for you the moment it’s created.

🎁 WHAT YOU GET:
• 1 Core Collectible NFT from our exclusive set of 6 rarities:

🟩 Common (55% chance)

🟦 Uncommon (25% chance)

🟪 Rare (10% chance)

🔥 Epic (6.5% chance)

🌟 Legendary (2.5% chance)

👑 Mythic (1% chance)

These are the heart of the PIXEL kARTs universe—each one represents a key chapter in our racing saga, and they’re only available during this blend period! 💎

• 🌐 Main Site: https://pixelkarts.app/			
• 📊 WAXDAO Pool: https://waxdao.io/v2/farm/pixelkartsco			




**UNTIL THE END OF THE EVENT**

PIXEL kARTs brings you the Blending GP Event — a high-octane challenge where speed, luck, and blending strategy collide!

Be one of the first 3 racers to blend and collect all 6 unique PIXEL kARTs Collectables!
